record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — totalPages is off by one for exact multiples of limit (50 users / limit 50 gives 2 pages), so "next" is enabled and pages to an empty member list

adjudication.rationale: `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2). This makes `showingLast` false on page 1, enabling the `next` action. `next` sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` (=> 50), and `findMembers()` then requests `/members.json` with `offset=50`, which the server applies directly (`limit(...).offset(offset)`), yielding an empty members list. So the diff introduces the off-by-one paging bug described.
